svg.title: How feature-coordinator runs one feature across many repositories
svg.desc: Diagram: on your machine, a coordinator session in the anchor repo researches every repository, then writes the research notes, the plan and the locked contracts into shared files; one worker session per repository, each in its own git worktree with a guard and a stop gate, reads them and works in parallel. Each worker opens a draft PR on its own repo's host - GitHub, Azure DevOps Server, GitLab, or a review packet for a local repo with no remote - as soon as it starts. The coordinator marks each PR ready when its merge step comes. You approve the spec and plan, answer the workers' questions, and merge the ready PRs in plan order.
